name: Sue Lines The opposition asked a while ago for the bills to be split. The question is that the remaining stages of the Treasury Laws Amendment (Responsible Buy Now Pay Later and Other Measures) Bill 2024 be agreed to and the bill be now passed. Question agreed to. Bill read a third time. The question now is that the remaining stages of the Capital Works (Build to Rent Misuse Tax) Bill 2024 be agreed to and the bill be now passed.
